# StateView

One region, every state, one prop.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.StateView` · Feedback



## Notes

One region, every state, one prop: loading, refreshing, ready, empty, partial and six kinds of error.

## Props (StateViewProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `'loading' \| 'refreshing' \| 'ready' \| 'empty' \| 'partial' \| 'error' \| 'offline' \| 'timeout' \| 'not-f…` | Which state the region is in. @default "ready" |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The real content (ready, partial, refreshing). |
| `skeleton` | `SkeletonPresetProps['kind'] \| React.ReactNode` | A SkeletonPreset kind, or your own skeleton node. @default "list" |
| `skeletonCount` | `number` |  |
| `label` | `string` | Spoken loading and done labels. |
| `doneLabel` | `string` |  |
| `empty` | `Partial<EmptyStateProps> & { children?: React.ReactNode }` | Props for the EmptyState (title, children, action, icon, scene…). |
| `error` | `Partial<ErrorStateProps>` | Props for the ErrorState (title, children, details, action…). |
| `partial` | `{ title?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode; action?: React.ReactNode }` | The warning shown above children when status is "partial". |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  |
| `retrying` | `boolean` |  |
| `minHeight` | `number \| string` | Keep the region this tall in every state, so switching never jolts the page. |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
